_comment: Pinned inputs, per ci.md section 6. Reproducibility is worth nothing if
the inputs move. Entries under 'pinned' are bumped only in a dedicated
commit; entries under 'recorded' cannot be pinned and are captured per
run instead, where they are a valid explanation for a timing change and
Gate B0.4 is 'required': Slang, meshoptimizer and clusterlod.h versions
pinned and recorded in every manifest. An entry whose version is null is
UNPINNED and fails 'xmake ci-pins'. Do not invent a version to make the
check pass -- fill it in from the dependency you actually vendored.

slang.bump_policy: Named new baseline. Shader hashes change, so golden images are re-verified before the reference is updated.

meshoptimizer.bump_policy: Treated as a content format change: full re-cook, new package hashes, named new baseline. Bumped together with clusterlod_h, never alone.
meshoptimizer.note: Pinned to a commit, not to the v1.2 release. clusterlod.h at the same commit calls meshopt_SimplifyErrorClamped and meshopt_SimplifyPreserveFolds, and neither symbol exists in v1.2. Verified 2026-09-15: 21 translation units plus a clusterlod.h implementation unit compile and link under -std=c++23.

clusterlod_h.bump_policy: Treated as a content format change: full re-cook, new package hashes, named new baseline. Its API is explicitly evolving upstream, so a bump is never routine. Bumped together with meshoptimizer, never alone.
clusterlod_h.note: Vendored from the upstream demo/ directory, which tracks master rather than releases. Upstream last touched this file on 2026-09-12 ('demo: Implement optional border dilation for clusterlod'), three days before pinning. The sha256 proves the vendored bytes are the pinned commit's bytes; editing the file in place is a silent fork and fails the check.

vulkan_instance.note: SDK and driver cannot be pinned. Recorded per run. A correctness failure that coincides with a driver update is still a correctness failure until proven otherwise.

xmake.note: Build driver. Recorded so a build-system change is visible in the manifest.

clang_format.note: Formatting is a push-tier check; a clang-format major bump reformats the tree and must be a deliberate commit.
